Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

RE-Bench: Evaluating frontier AI R&D capabilities of language model agents against human experts (2411.15114v1) · paper method: The authors report o1-preview with AIDE matching the 36th percentile of human experts in their best-of-k comparison.

cohort6.claim.rebench.agent-result

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific reported method or result; no experiment, proof, raw-corpus record or labor audit was independently reproduced.
  • Seven environments; sampled shorter attempts use a shared total time budget. This percentile does not establish end-to-end research automation.
  • The 36th percentile belongs to the eight-total-hour-per-environment best-of-k comparison. Shorter agent attempts are sampled with replacement and the highest achieved score across k runs is selected, except in Scaling Law Experiment, where selection is random because the agent cannot access its achieved score.
